Name: Dawn's Florist Gown - Dress Set for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
This was my first mod commission, and it was a great learning experience and so fun to make! I'm really happy with how it turned out! ^-^ This was also my first time making sleeves for FS, which turned out to be way more work than I realized. lol But it was totally worth it!

The outfit was commissioned by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Hiname/mods]Hiname[/url] to match one of her OC's, so the design of the outfit goes to her. (ᵔ◡ᵔ)

This set includes a shirt, skirt, sleeves, and a flower crown. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25106]Dawn's Hummingbird Wings[/url] was also made as part of this outfit commission, but I decided to post them separately.


To install:
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]!
Unzip the file and move the folder "[FS] Dawn's Florist Gown" into your StardewValley/mods folder. Done!


If you'd like to support my mods, [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]consider buying me a coffee[/url]. Don't feel obligated though. (￣▽￣*)ゞ I'll also be accepting commissions there in the future!
